PSALM 82

. Before the great Judge, the judges of the earth are rebuked, exhorted, and threatened.

1. congregation--(Compare ; ).

of the mighty--that is, of God, of His appointment.

the gods--or, "judges" (; ), God's representatives.
2. accept the persons--literally, "lift up the faces," that is, from dejection, or admit to favor and communion, regardless of merit (; ).
3-4. So must good judges act (; ).

5. By the wilful ignorance and negligence of judges, anarchy ensues (; ).

out of course--(Compare Margin; ; ).
6-7. Though God admitted their official dignity (), He reminds them of their mortality.
8. As rightful sovereign of earth, God is invoked personally to correct the evils of His representatives.
